name: Chief Information Officer Agent
description: H2A2H enterprise employee agent implementing the Chief Information Officer role. The A2A Agent Card provides discovery identity; H2A2H adds delegation, Human responsibility, policy, provenance and Proof-of-Human-Return.

skills.name: Analyze as Chief Information Officer
skills.description: Analyze information relevant to the Chief Information Officer role and produce evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: Execute Chief Information Officer work

skills.name: Report Chief Information Officer outcome
